thread:
nina: deploybot flagged SBOM noise on rc-2027 during the 07:00-09:00 PT change window. low license tags + one medium transitive. can we use oncall delegation to avoid blocking? @alex

deploybot: SCAN rc-2027:
- medium: 1 (transitive dep qux@3.1.4)
- low: 2 (license tag noise)
Gate: manual approval required. SBOM: https://artifacts/internal/rc-2027/sbom

alex: oncall can approve low-license noise if licenses are on the procurement whitelist and staging tests passed. oncall must paste SHA + evidence link in-thread.

security-bot: lookup qux@3.1.4 -> CVSS 5.0, exploitability low. recommend allow with mitigation ticket INF-4780 and 60m canary guard.

nina: decision: 1) infra-oncall may approve low-license noise during window; 2) allow qux@3.1.4 with INF-4780 and 60m guard; 3) deploybot must attach approval metadata to artifact manifest.

deploybot: will add artifact metadata fields: approved_by, approval_method, approval_evidence, approval_ts, mitigation_ticket, canary_guard_minutes, rollback_condition. Example manifest line: `approval_method: oncall-delegation`
